name: survey-report
description: Turn a survey export into a finished report. Drop in the spreadsheet from your form tool — one row per response — and every question gets its type detected (single choice, multiple choice, rating, NPS, number or open text), a bar or pie chart, counts and percentages. Rename questions, switch chart types, leave questions out, and cross-tab everything by one question such as age group or channel. Export a one-page HTML report, an A4 PDF and an Excel workbook with the numbers, cross-tabs and every open answer. Runs locally; no form-tool login or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把问卷导出表变成一份完整报告。放入问卷工具导出的表格（每行一份回答），每道题自动识别题型（单选、多选、评分、NPS、数字、开放题），生成柱状图或饼图、人数和占比。可以改题目文字、换图表、去掉某些题，还能按一道题（如年龄段、渠道）对所有题做交叉分析。导出网页报告、A4 PDF 和 Excel（含统计、交叉表和全部文字回答）。在本地运行，不用登录问卷平台，无需 API 密钥。
